dataset.name: market1501
dataset.description: Market-1501 (Zheng et al., ICCV 2015): bounding_box_train + bounding_box_test pooled; identities with id <= 0 (junk/distractors) are dropped by the loader. This copy came from a third-party mirror and has NO official query/ folder, so the official Market-1501 query/gallery protocol is NOT reproduced; the project's own identity-disjoint dev/calibration/test protocol is used instead.
dataset.license_note: Non-commercial research use only (Zheng et al., ICCV 2015). Never redistribute or commit.

model.name: osnet_x1_0
model.weights_license: MIT (Torchreid); see training-data caveat in the README
model.weights_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/aveocr/Market-1501-v15.09.15.zip (third-party mirror of the official Torchreid file osnet_ms_d_c.pth.tar, pinned by SHA-256; upstream: https://kaiyangzhou.github.io/deep-person-reid/MODEL_ZOO)
model.training_data: MSMT17 + DukeMTMC-reID + CUHK03 (multi-source domain generalisation); Market-1501 is NOT in the training data

calibration.regions: torso + legs, HSV 8x3x3 histograms, Bhattacharyya similarity
calibration.note: A proxy for same-clothing look-alikes - Market-1501 has no clothing labels.

performance.note: Measured on this machine in steady state after warm-up; model load and warm-up are separate.

nn_baseline.label: Nearest neighbour (no rejection)
nn_baseline.description: Always names the closest enrolled person. Closed-set behaviour; cannot say 'unknown'.

thr.label: + Calibrated threshold
thr.description: Accept only if the top-1 similarity reaches a threshold chosen on the calibration split.

notes: The requested operating point could NOT be met on the calibration data (DIR@1 (accepted and correct) >= 90.0%, minimise FAR). The threshold shown is only a best-effort fallback (accept every query that scores at least as high as the lowest observed score) and must not be treated as calibrated.
